patch_description: The bottleneck is the per-step LP re-solve (dense constraint assembly with Python loops). This rewrite vectorizes the LP construction: pairwise indices via `np.triu_indices`, distances via one broadcasting call, and the constraint matrix as a `scipy.sparse.csr_matrix`. This cuts per-step LP cost severalfold, allowing the hill-climb to run many more exact-LP- evaluated steps within the same runtime budget. I also keep the fast iterative radii solver as a cheap pre-screen (only accept candidate moves whose fast radii sum already beats the current one before paying for the LP), which further increases effective step count. Multi-start over the same hex-row layouts is retained.
